assets.name: greybridge-dusk
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original wide illustrated website background for the Chinese fantasy novel 九域守界, landscape 2048 x 1152.
Primary request: an atmospheric establishing view of 灰桥, a small lived-in riverside town at blue-hour dusk, with a worn gray stone bridge across quiet water, warm little windows, layered distant hills and faint stars. This is a decorative backdrop for a dark navy and muted antique-gold literary character archive website.
Style/medium: polished painterly fantasy illustration, delicate architectural detail, lightly textured brushwork, grounded and tranquil, a natural blend of East Asian riverside houses and restrained old European fantasy architecture consistent with the world's diverse character costumes.
Composition/framing: broad panoramic landscape. The site's title is on the left, so left half has calm, softly shaded open sky and water with restrained low-contrast detail; the stone bridge and warmly lit town sit toward the lower middle and right, with layered atmospheric depth. Keep important forms within the central vertical area so a mobile crop still shows bridge, water, and town.
Lighting/mood: dusk, welcoming, quietly mysterious, small amber reflections in deep blue-gray water, no disaster or battle.
Color palette: ink navy #101b25, slate blue, desaturated teal, warm antique gold #d6ba82.
Constraints: environment only, no characters, no text, no typography, no logos, no borders, no watermark. Not a website mockup. No symbols or illustrations of story endings. Maintain usable negative space for legible live HTML text.

assets.name: moonlit-archive
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original wide landscape illustrated website background, 2048 x 1152, for the character archive and character-detail pages of the Chinese fantasy novel 九域守界.
Primary request: a quiet, moonlit old archive interior, shelves of leather-bound books and rolled papers, tall arched windows, a modest brass lamp, worn wooden tables, antique architectural detail. Match a dark ink-navy and muted antique-gold fantasy website.
Style/medium: finely painted fantasy environment illustration with tactile wood, paper, old brass and blue stone; elegant, restrained, natural painterly texture, not a photograph.
Composition/framing: wide panoramic establishing view. Architecture and shelves frame the far edges. Keep the central half spacious, shadowed, uncluttered and low-contrast for live HTML page titles and character portraits. A tall window and gentle shaft of blue moonlight near the upper right, small warm lamp light at the edge, richly detailed edge areas; good visual crop on portrait phone screens. No close-up props obstructing the middle.
Lighting/mood: quiet blue hour, soft moonlight, warm small lamplight, calm sense of opening a living archive, subtle dust motes, no spooky horror.
Color palette: ink navy #101b25, slate blue, restrained blue teal, dark wood and warm antique gold #d6ba82.
Constraints: scenery only, no people, no faces, no legible text or writing, no logos, no ornamental borders, no watermark. Not a UI screenshot. No invented lore symbols, secret plot clues, or ending imagery.
